units.source_text: 這並不是因為我善於說謊，有時候我甚至把事情說得再明白不過，

en.t: This was not because I was good at lying; sometimes I even explained things with absolute clarity,

units.source_text: 但良子好像只當笑話來聽。

en.t: but Yoshiko seemed to hear it all only as a joke.
"You have not changed much, have you? Still so full of yourself.

units.source_text: 其實也沒什麼事啦，她只是託我告訴你，有空也到高円寺來玩。」

en.t: Actually, it is nothing important. She just asked me to tell you to come visit Koenji sometime when you are free."

units.source_text: 剛要忘掉時，一隻怪鳥振翅飛來，用鳥喙啄破我記憶的傷口。

en.t: Just as I was about to forget, a strange bird came flying in, beating its wings, and pecked open the wound in my memory with its beak.

units.source_text: 我過去的羞恥和罪惡的記憶，忽然之間又清晰地浮現眼前，

en.t: The memories of my past shame and sins suddenly appeared clearly before my eyes again,

units.source_text: 哇——想放聲尖叫的恐懼襲來，讓我坐立不安。

en.t: and a terror that made me want to cry out, "Aah!" came over me, leaving me unable to sit still.

units.source_text: 外表上頗為相似，有時甚至覺得兩個人長得一模一樣。

en.t: Outwardly we were quite alike, and at times I even felt the two of us looked exactly the same.
